## Registry Aggregator 0.4.14

This release publishes the package from the canonical renamed repository through npm Trusted Publishing.

### Highlights

- canonical repository: `Stolyarovmn/dsh-ui-registry-aggregator`;
- npm package: `@stolyarovmn/dsh-ui-registry-aggregator`;
- Trusted Publisher uses `.github/workflows/publish.yml`;
- README screenshots and repository metadata point to the renamed repository;
- Browse/search behavior is unchanged from the working 0.4.13 baseline;
- GitHub stars remain hydrated asynchronously after results render.

### Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness: `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2.0`
- tested with DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`
